name: Nycticebus bengalensis
note: One call recorded in GKVK Botanical Gardens, Bengaluru (xeno-canto XC1033634, 2025): far outside its range in the North-East; captive or a misidentified call (Bengaluru has the Slender Loris)

name: Lonchura oryzivora
note: One eBird record in Bengaluru (2025): a cage bird from Java and Bali, not established in India

name: Artocarpus heterophyllus
note: Jackfruit: Kew gives its native range as SW India; in 24 Paraganas South its records are of planted trees

name: Cajanus cajan
note: Pigeon Pea: a crop, grown in fields; Kew's range is the crop's origin, not wild plants here
